ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.

2. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.

7. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

8. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

9. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

10. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Solar Photovoltaic Installation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Lamps and Lamp Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Combinational Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Home- based Automatic Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
